title: The Hadwiger Covering Conjecture
exact_target: Can every convex body be covered by at most two to the dimension smaller translated and positively scaled copies of itself?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1213 (GEO-022). CC BY 4.0.
Andrii Arman, Andriy Bondarenko and Andriy Prymak, \emph{On Hadwiger\textquotesingle s covering problem in small dimensions}, arXiv:2404.00547v1 (2024), Section 1.
